item.title: Muslim man hailed as hero after wrestling Bondi attacker with his bare hands
item.description: When two men opened fire on crowds gathered to celebrate Hanukkah on Bondi Beach in Australia, one man stepped in to stop it. Ahmed al-Ahmed, 43, took on one of the shooters and wrestled him to the ground, preventing the death of potentially many more people. #BondiBeach #antiSemitism #terrorism

item.title: Nigerian expert warns of another 'Christmas massacre'
item.description: A religious freedom advocate is warning of the potential for another “Christmas massacre” in Nigeria as Christians in the country continue to experience targeted attacks on an unprecedented level. #Nigeria #GiaChacon #Religiousfreedom

item.title: Son accused of murdering Christian singer Jubilant Sykes was homeless, battling mental illness
item.description: Micah Sykes, the 31-year-old son of Grammy-nominated Christian singer Jubilant Sykes, who has been charged with his murder, was homeless and struggling with mental illness for years, according to the Los Angeles County District Attorney’s Office. #MicahSykes #JubilantSykes #GraceCommunityChurch #MentalIllness

item.title: Son of 'Spinal Tap' filmmaker Rob Reiner arrested after parents found dead in LA-area home
item.description: Nick Reiner, the son of Oscar-nominated filmmaker Rob Reiner, was arrested Sunday after Reiner and his wife were found dead in their Los Angeles-area home. #RobReiner #NickReiner #DonaldTrump

item.title: Rep. Dan Crenshaw challenges Shawn Ryan to interview after alleged lawsuit threat: 'SEAL to SEAL'
item.description: Rep. Dan Crenshaw, R-Texas, challenged conservative podcast host and former Navy SEAL Shawn Ryan to a one-on-one interview after Ryan claimed last week that Crenshaw was threatening to sue him for defamation after raising questions about Crenshaw's net worth since becoming a member of Congress. #DanCrenshaw #ShawnRyan #NavySEAL #politics

item.title: Germany: 5 arrested in Islamist-motivated plot to attack Christmas market
item.description: Five men have been arrested on suspicion of planning an Islamist-motivated vehicle attack at a Christmas market in southern Germany. The suspects had intended to drive a car into a crowd, aiming to kill or injure as many people as possible, according to authorities. #Islamist #VehicleAttack #ChristmasMarketAttack #Germany #Killing #Terror

item.title: Top 6 moments from Erika Kirk's CBS interview with Bari Weiss: 'Let the Lord use it'
item.description: Erika Kirk, the widow of the late conservative political activist and Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk, recently discussed her Christian faith, the prosecution of her husband's alleged killer, and what good she hopes God will bring out of evil. #ErikaKirk #CharlieKirk #TurningPointUSA #BariWeiss #CBSNews

item.title: Dept. of Education affirms Grand Canyon University's nonprofit status after years-long battle
item.description: The U.S. Department of Education has affirmed the nonprofit status of Grand Canyon University, following years of legal battles the largest Christian institution of higher learning in the U.S. has waged against the federal government. #GrandCanyonUniversity #DepartmentofEducation #education

item.title: Bondi Beach attack update: ISIS-affiliated flag, undetonated IEDs found
item.description: Two men, identified as Sajid Akram and his son Naveed Akram, opened fire at a Hanukkah gathering in Australia’s Bondi Beach, killing 15 people in what authorities are calling an anti-Semitic terror attack. Police fatally shot the elder Akram at the scene while the younger suspect remains in critical condition under guard. #BondiBeachShooting #TerrorAttack #AntiSemitism #SajidAkram #NaveedAkram #Hanukkah #JewishPeopleinAustralia #Killing #HateCrime #Palestinian

item.title: FBI foils New Year’s Eve bombing plot, arrests 4 alleged suspects in ‘radical’ anti-ICE group
item.description: Federal authorities have arrested alleged suspects in a far-left domestic terror group that was planning to detonate a series of explosive devices on New Year’s Eve. #Antifa #TurtleIslandLiberationFront #Trump #extremism #NewYearsEve #DOJ #FBI
